Name: Stick Figure Lamps
Author: WidowStar
Description: My first mod ever: Turning every standing lamp into a stick figure. 2 variants included: blue when off - red when on, and red when off - blue when on. Might make new variants in the future if I feel like it. Just made this for fun and to test making mods for this game.

Downloads.Description: Drag and Drop contents into Mods folder
